n311e0cde61.headline: Rabitabank launches Mudaraba and Murabaha Islamic banking products in Azerbaijan
n311e0cde61.summary: Rabitabank has launched Mudaraba and Murabaha Islamic banking products in Azerbaijan. The move is presented as a step toward alternative financial needs within the banking sector.
n311e0cde61.why: Islamic finance products such as Mudaraba and Murabaha are profit-sharing and cost-plus financing structures that expand a bank's customer base in markets with demand for Sharia-compliant services.

nc8d1e3a8a5.headline: Saudi Printing and Packaging to close UAE subsidiary
nc8d1e3a8a5.summary: Saudi Printing and Packaging's board approved the closure of its UAE subsidiary. The decision is part of the company's strategy to review and exit non-core assets.
nc8d1e3a8a5.why: Asset exits and subsidiary closures are common restructuring steps that show how listed companies reshape their portfolios and focus on core operations.

n5db94ec9d7.headline: Fiscal Stability Clause: Greece's National Priority
n5db94ec9d7.summary: Deputy Prime Minister Hatzidakis defended constitutional fiscal stability as essential for growth, investment and intergenerational fairness. He outlined Greece's 2026 reform agenda.
n5db94ec9d7.why: Fiscal rules constrain government spending and borrowing, which influence sovereign debt risk and bond yields for Greece and the euro area.

n5f1bafefa7.headline: Gold rebounds above $5,000 after US downs Iran drone
n5f1bafefa7.summary: Gold prices rebounded above $5,000 an ounce after the US downed an Iranian drone. Investors continue to move into safe-haven assets as geopolitical tensions rise.
n5f1bafefa7.why: Gold is a traditional safe-haven asset that investors buy during geopolitical stress and as a hedge against currency and inflation risk.

impacts.name: Gold
impacts.why: The report says gold rebounded above $5,000 amid geopolitical tensions that push investors toward safe-haven assets.

n5f1bafefa7.why_moved: The report links the gold rebound to geopolitical tensions after the US downed an Iranian drone, which typically drives demand for safe-haven assets.

n7a46c5a434.headline: Inflation Trends in Greece & Eurozone 2026
n7a46c5a434.summary: Greek inflation eased to 2.8% in January 2026, while eurozone inflation fell to 1.7%. Energy prices dropped sharply, while services prices remained elevated.
n7a46c5a434.why: Inflation data shapes European Central Bank policy expectations, which affect euro-area bond yields and borrowing costs.

n159ab619d0.headline: Malawi: Reserve Bank of Malawi to Compensate Finance Bank With Billions Over Wrongful Closure
n159ab619d0.summary: The Reserve Bank of Malawi is expected to compensate Finance Bank over its wrongful closure, following a Supreme Court of Appeal ruling in Blantyre. The compensation amount is in billions.
n159ab619d0.why: The central bank regulates Malawi's banking sector, and its actions affect the solvency and investor confidence of commercial lenders.

n69780ecab6.headline: RBI panel starts meet on interest rate; announcement Friday - OrissaPOST
n69780ecab6.summary: The RBI's six-member Monetary Policy Committee, headed by Governor Sanjay Malhotra, began deliberations on interest rates on Wednesday. The decision will be announced Friday morning.
n69780ecab6.why: The Reserve Bank of India sets the country's benchmark policy rate, which influences borrowing costs, the rupee and local equity valuations.

n85d923fa1b.headline: Athens Stock Exchange Up 0.45% Amid Mixed EU Markets
n85d923fa1b.summary: The Athens Stock Exchange opened 0.45% higher, with Lamda Development and Coca-Cola HBC leading gains. European markets were mixed.
n85d923fa1b.why: The Athens General Composite is Greece's main equity benchmark, and Coca-Cola HBC and Lamda Development are among its notable listed companies.

n7e9b0b09c7.headline: Triodos becomes the first international bank to secure Fair Tax Mark
n7e9b0b09c7.summary: Triodos Bank has become the first international bank to secure the Fair Tax Mark, a label for responsible tax conduct. The label is awarded to companies meeting a responsible-tax standard.
n7e9b0b09c7.why: Tax-conduct certifications affect how investors and clients assess a bank's governance and reputational risk.

n777d91a839.headline: KOSPI tops 5,300 on AI optimism, market reform hopes
n777d91a839.summary: South Korea's KOSPI set a record high on Wednesday, topping 5,300 points for the first time. Investors continued buying artificial intelligence-related stocks.
n777d91a839.why: The KOSPI is the benchmark index of the Korea Exchange and includes large technology and industrial companies. Its moves reflect sentiment toward Korean equities and the semiconductor sector.

impacts.name: KOSPI
impacts.why: The index set a record high by topping 5,300 points, driven by AI-related buying.

n777d91a839.why_moved: Investors continued buying artificial intelligence-related stocks, and hopes for market reform were cited, pushing the index to a record.

nd4ee4f4b3f.headline: Vietnam opens stock market wider to foreign investors
nd4ee4f4b3f.summary: Vietnam's Ministry of Finance issued rules allowing foreign investors to trade through global brokerage firms without opening accounts at domestic securities companies, aiming to support an emerging market upgrade.
nd4ee4f4b3f.why: Market accessibility rules affect foreign capital flows and index inclusion decisions. Emerging market upgrades by index providers can attract passive investment.

nc4f0cc0f54.headline: Athens Stock Exchange Hits 16-Year High
nc4f0cc0f54.summary: The Athens Stock Exchange closed at a 16-year high on February 4, 2026. The General Index rose 1.56% to 2,407.07 points, with strong gains across major stocks.
nc4f0cc0f54.why: The Athens Stock Exchange is Greece's national bourse, and its General Index tracks the performance of the country's listed companies.
nc4f0cc0f54.why_moved: Strong gains across major stocks lifted the General Index 1.56% to a 16-year high.

n2e532db2bb.headline: India to lower tariffs on vast array of US industrial, agricultural goods to zero per cent: USTR - OrissaPOST
n2e532db2bb.summary: India will lower tariffs on a 'vast array' of American industrial and agricultural goods, including fruits and vegetables, to zero under a trade deal announced by President Trump, USTR Jamieson Greer said.
n2e532db2bb.why: Tariff changes under a bilateral deal alter export opportunities for US farm and industrial producers and import costs for Indian buyers.

n6dba42adab.headline: Toyota tumbles, China dominates, petrol plummets and we abandon US-style pickups like the Ford F-150 and Chevrolet Silverado as Australia's best selling vehicles revealed
n6dba42adab.summary: Toyota fell in Australia's new-car sales early in 2026, while Chinese brands gained strongly. The report also notes falling petrol prices and weaker demand for US-style pickups such as the Ford F-150.
n6dba42adab.why: Toyota is Australia's largest-selling car brand, so shifts in its sales reflect changes in consumer demand and competition from Chinese automakers.

nf5c809ef52.headline: Indonesia exceeds 2025 tourism target with 15.39 million visitors
nf5c809ef52.summary: Indonesia recorded 15.39 million foreign tourist arrivals in 2025, surpassing the government's target, Tourism Minister Widiyanti Putri Wardhana said.
nf5c809ef52.why: Tourism spending supports hotels, airlines and retail in Indonesia, and arrival targets are a key measure of the sector's growth.

n1ba44eec0f.headline: AI scatters the tech herd
n1ba44eec0f.summary: Market commentary says the AI wave clearly does not float all boats, with a sharp Tuesday shakeout hitting shares of some technology companies.
n1ba44eec0f.why: Investor sentiment toward AI-linked technology stocks drives large swings in US and global equity indexes, so dispersion within the sector matters for portfolios.
n1ba44eec0f.why_moved: Shares in some technology companies were hit by a sharp shakeout on Tuesday, while the AI wave lifted others.

nb6def09f2d.headline: India, Indonesia only major EM markets in 2026 to decline amid global EM rally: Deutsche Bank
nb6def09f2d.summary: Emerging markets showed resilience and a strong start to 2026 despite volatility, according to a Deutsche Bank report. India and Indonesia remained the only major underperformers.
nb6def09f2d.why: Deutsche Bank is a global investment bank whose research on emerging markets informs institutional allocation between countries.

ndab79ce612.headline: China Slams EU Goldwind Probe as Discriminatory
ndab79ce612.summary: China condemned the EU's anti-subsidy investigation into Goldwind, calling it protectionist and harmful to bilateral business trust. The probe targets the Chinese wind turbine maker.
ndab79ce612.why: Goldwind is a major Chinese wind turbine manufacturer, and EU anti-subsidy probes can lead to duties that affect its access to European markets.

n13501d2c26.headline: Vietnam, Jordan target $1bn two-way trade by 2035
n13501d2c26.summary: Vietnam and Jordan agreed to raise bilateral trade to US$1 billion by 2035. Jordan proposed a free trade zone for Vietnamese goods to serve Middle Eastern markets.
n13501d2c26.why: Trade agreements and free trade zones can open new export channels for Vietnamese manufacturers into the Middle East.

nd252057733.headline: Barclays sees rising risk premium weighing on US dollar
nd252057733.summary: Barclays expects a sustained dollar risk premium that could support the yen and select Asian currencies. It would limit upside for the euro and raise sensitivity to Fed policy shifts.
nd252057733.why: The US dollar is the world's main reserve currency, and shifts in its risk premium affect global currency and capital flows.

n8f1f8fa6fa.headline: Watch out Zeekr, Euro brand preps new hero SUV: 2026 Volkswagen ID.Era 9X revealed in China as a Zeekr 9X, BYD Tang 9 and Leapmotor D16 rival
n8f1f8fa6fa.summary: Volkswagen revealed the 2026 ID.Era 9X in China, a model rivalling the Zeekr 9X, BYD Tang 9 and Leapmotor D16. The launch reflects intensifying competition in China's electric SUV segment.
n8f1f8fa6fa.why: Volkswagen is one of the world's largest automakers, and its China product launches affect its competitiveness in the world's biggest car market.

neea1cf6b33.headline: Evogene Licenses Microbiome-Based Cancer Therapeutic BMC128 To Shanghai Lishan Biopharmaceuticals
neea1cf6b33.summary: Evogene has signed an exclusive worldwide licensing agreement for BMC128 with Shanghai Lishan Biopharmaceuticals. BMC128 is a microbiome-based therapy completing Phase 1 studies in renal cell and non-small cell lung cancer.
neea1cf6b33.why: Licensing deals let drug developers monetize early-stage assets through partners that fund later clinical development. Milestone and royalty terms determine how much value flows back to the licensor.

nf1e3241938.headline: Trump Says He Discussed Iran with China’s Xi as US Pushes Beijing and Others to Isolate Tehran
nf1e3241938.summary: President Trump said he and Chinese President Xi Jinping discussed Iran in a wide-ranging call. The US administration is reportedly pushing Beijing and others to isolate Tehran, and trade and Taiwan were also on the agenda.
nf1e3241938.why: US-China relations shape global trade, tariffs and sanctions enforcement, all of which affect energy prices and multinational supply chains.

n175a99cf2e.headline: $500bn mobile money puts Africa fintech in AI league
n175a99cf2e.summary: Vodacom’s mobile money platform has reached $500.7 billion in transaction volume, demonstrating Africa’s advanced financial technology ecosystem.
n175a99cf2e.why: Mobile money platforms are transforming financial inclusion and economic activity across Africa, attracting global fintech interest.

ne1d52cfa8c.headline: Liberia: LEC Admits Owing Swedish Firm Eltel Over U.S.$415k
ne1d52cfa8c.summary: LEC formally admitted owing over $415,000 to Swedish engineering firm Eltel Network-Liberia for electrical materials supplied under a 2016 agreement.
ne1d52cfa8c.why: Recognition of public utility debts affects creditworthiness and supplier relations in emerging markets.

n316173c86e.headline: House Sets Up Conference Committee on CBL Audit Report
n316173c86e.summary: Liberia’s House of Representatives established a conference committee to review the Central Bank of Liberia audit report.
n316173c86e.why: Central bank audits affect financial sector transparency and policy; parliamentary review can influence regulatory and fiscal decisions.

nb16383af11.headline: Equinor Reports Lower Q4 Earnings as Record Production Supports Cash Flow
nb16383af11.summary: Equinor closed 2025 with record production levels but reported lower fourth-quarter earnings amid lower commodity prices and adjusted capital allocation.
nb16383af11.why: Equinor is a major Norwegian energy company; its earnings and production levels are key indicators for the oil sector and Norwegian economy.

impacts.why: Lower earnings despite record production reflect commodity price pressure.

nc319704f37.headline: Equinor Slashes 2026 Buybacks as Low Oil Prices Persist
nc319704f37.summary: Equinor sharply reduced its planned 2026 share buybacks after narrowly missing Q4 earnings estimates due to lower oil and European gas prices despite record annual output.
nc319704f37.why: Equinor is a major Norwegian energy company whose financial decisions reflect the impact of commodity price fluctuations on energy producers.
nc319704f37.why_moved: Equinor's reduction in buybacks due to weaker oil and gas prices and earnings shortfall likely pressured its stock and signaled caution in the energy sector.
